records.text: Owens asked whether the anonymous French-American donor named Pierre was Pierre S. du Pont.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And I would like a clean answer as to whether or not it is Mr. Pierre du Pont.

verification.notes: The transcript verifies that Owens posed the question, but the underlying identification was a hypothesis built from an anonymous first name and French-American description. No donor record or documentary evidence in this episode establishes Pierre S. du Pont as the person described.
